title: Expose aisle config from catalog
description: Extend the app-side aisle catalog so the parsed `AisleConfig` is retained and exposed for aggregation flows, while keeping aisle-name fallback behavior intact.
acceptance_criteria: `load(from:)` stores parsed config on success and clears it on missing or failed config loads.
`aisles` stays derived from `config?.sections` or falls back to default aisles.

handoff_summary.completed: All three acceptance criteria satisfied: config property added, stored on success/cleared on failure, aisles derived from config?.sections with fallback.
handoff_summary.risks: None. Change is additive — existing `aisles` and `isLoaded` behavior is preserved.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify the new config property is accessible and the fallback/store behavior is correct.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No conflicts expected. Only AisleCatalog.swift was modified; no sibling beads touch this file.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used `config?.sections ?? []` instead of force-unwrapping after assignment, keeping nil-safety consistent with the optional type.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tests should cover: (1) config is nil after load with missing file, (2) config is populated after successful parse, (3) aisles falls back to defaultAisles when config is nil or sections is empty.

conflict_risks: No conflicts expected. Only AisleCatalog.swift was modified; no sibling beads touch this file.

execution_history.summary: Added `private(set) var config: AisleConfig?` to `AisleCatalog`. On successful parse, `config` is set to the parsed value; on missing/unreadable file, it is cleared to `nil`. The `aisles` property is now derived from `config?.sections` with fallback to `defaultAisles`, satisfying all three acceptance criteria.
